rules.name: Deathwatch Mission Tactics
rules.effect:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the Mission Tactics found below. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Mission Tactic is active and its effects apply to all ^^Deathwatch^^ units in your army. Each Mission Tactic can only be selected once per battle.


**Furor Tactics**
While this Mission Tactic is active, weapons equipped by ^^Deathwatch^^ units from your army have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.


**Malleus Tactics**
While this Mission Tactic is active, weapons equipped by ^^Deathwatch^^ units from your army have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.


**Purgatus Tactics**
While this Mission Tactic is active, each time a ^^Deathwatch^^ model from your army makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, that attack has the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One DEATHWATCH unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.summary: -1 AP on incoming attacks.

stratagems.name: Adaptive Tactics
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase.
stratagems.cond: One DEATHWATCH unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select the Furor Tactics, Malleus Tactics or Purgatus Tactics. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Deathwatch Mission Tactic is active for your unit instead of any other Deathwatch Mission Tactic that is active for your army, even if you have already selected that Deathwatch Mission Tactic this battle.
stratagems.summary: Choose Furor/Malleus/Purgatus Tactics; active for this unit instead of army tactic until start of next Command phase.

stratagems.name: Hellfire Rounds
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One DEATHWATCH INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons (excluding Devastating Wounds weapons) equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-INFANTRY 2+] and [ANTI-MONSTER 5+] abilities.
stratagems.summary: Grant [ANTI-INFANTRY 2+] and [ANTI-MONSTER 5+] to unit's ranged weapons (excl. Devastating Wounds).

stratagems.name: Dragonfire Rounds
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One DEATHWATCH INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.
stratagems.summary: Grant [ASSAULT] and [IGNORES COVER] to unit's ranged weapons.

stratagems.name: Kraken Rounds
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One DEATHWATCH INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1 and improve the Range characteristic of those weapons by 6".
stratagems.summary: +1 AP and +6" Range to unit's ranged weapons.

stratagems.name: Rapid Tactical Relocation
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One INQUISITOR or DEATHWATCH INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield. In the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase, set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy models.
stratagems.summary: Remove unit from battlefield; redeploy more than 8" from enemies next Movement phase.

enhancements.name: Universal Anathema
enhancements.effect: Melee weapons equipped by the bearer have the [ANTI-INFANTRY 2+] and [ANTI-MONSTER 4+] abilities

enhancements.name: Blackweave Shroud
enhancements.effect: The bearer has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

enhancements.name: Beacon Angelis
enhancements.effect: Models in the bearer's unit have the Deep Strike ability. In addition, you can target the bearer's unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP.

enhancements.name: Amulet of Auto-chastisement
enhancements.effect: At the start of your opponent's Shooting phase, select one enemy VEHICLE unit (excluding TITANIC units) within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That unit must take a Leadership test. If that test is passed, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. If that test is failed, that unit is not eligible to shoot this phase.

rules.name: Root Out Heresy
rules.effect:
Ranged weapons equipped by ^^Adeptus Arbites, Inquisitor, Inquisitorial Agents^^ and ^^Ordo Hereticus^^ models from your army have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.


Each time an ^^Adeptus Arbites, Inquisitor, Inquisitorial Agents^^ or ^^Ordo Hereticus^^ model from your army makes an attack that targets a ^^Chaos^^ unit containing 5 or more models, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

stratagems.name: Stun Grenades
stratagems.timing: Start of any phase (excluding the Command phase).
stratagems.cond: One ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS GRENADES unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS or VEHICLES) within 8" of and visible to your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test and, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.summary: Enemy unit within 8" takes Battle-shock test; -1 to Hit rolls until end of phase.

stratagems.name: Dispense Justice
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
stratagems.summary: Grant [LETHAL HITS] to unit's weapons.

stratagems.name: Inviolate Jurisdiction
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS INFANTRY unit from your army within range of an objective marker and that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
stratagems.summary: Grant Feel No Pain 5+ to unit.

stratagems.name: Execution Order
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase.
stratagems.cond: One ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy CHARACTER unit on the battlefield. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in your unit targets that CHARACTER unit, its weapons have the [PRECISION] ability.
stratagems.summary: Grant [PRECISION] against one enemy CHARACTER until your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: Line of Fire
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can target enemy units that are within Engagement Range of one or more friendly units with ranged weapons (excluding Blast weapons), provided the target is within 12".
stratagems.summary: Models in unit can target enemies in Engagement Range with ranged weapons (excl. Blast) if within 12".

stratagems.name: Exact Punishment
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit from your army is destroyed as the result of an enemy unit's attacks.
stratagems.cond: One ADEPTUS ARBITES, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS unit from your army that was within 6" of the destroyed unit (you cannot target the destroyed unit with the Stratagem).
stratagems.effect: After the attacking unit has shot, your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but when resolving those attacks it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target).
stratagems.summary: Unit shoots back at attacking unit as if in Shooting phase.

enhancements.name: Liber Heresius
enhancements.effect: After both players have deployed their armies, select up to 3 AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: No Escape
enhancements.effect: While an enemy unit is within 6" of the bearer, each time it is selected to Fall Back it must first take a Leadership test. If that test is failed, that unit must Remain Stationary this phase instead.

enhancements.name: Witch Hunter
enhancements.effect: While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack that targets a PSYKER unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Ignis Judicium
enhancements.effect: The bearer's ranged weapons have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS], [MELTA 1] and [PRECISION] abilities.

rules.name: Destroy the Daemonic
rules.effect: Each time an ^^Inquisitor, Inquisitorial Agents^^ or ^^Ordo Malleus^^ model from your army makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and, if the target is a ^^Daemon^^ unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 as well.

stratagems.name: Ritual of Warding
stratagems.timing: Start of any Command phase.
stratagems.cond: One INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO MALLEUS unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effect: That objective marker is said to be Warded and remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn. While an objective marker is Warded and under your control, enemy DAEMON units cannot be set up on the battlefield within 6" of it.
stratagems.summary: Objective becomes Warded: you retain control even without models in range until opponent controls it; enemy DAEMON units cannot set up within 6" of it.

stratagems.name: Rites of Exorcism
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One INQUISITOR, INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO MALLEUS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy DAEMON unit within 12" and visible to your unit. That unit must take a Battle-shock test. If that test is failed, then until the end of the phase, each time a friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit makes an attack that targets that DAEMON unit, that attack has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
stratagems.summary: Enemy DAEMON unit within 12" takes Battle-shock test; if failed, friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM attacks vs it gain [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] until end of phase.

stratagems.name: Steel Heart
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.cond: That GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.summary: Fell Back unit can shoot and declare charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Truesilver Armour
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase orthe Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.summary: -1 AP on incoming attacks.

stratagems.name: Hexagrammic Wards
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One ORDO MALLEUS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, all Psychic weapons equipped by models in the attacking unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.
stratagems.summary: Grant [HAZARDOUS] to attacking unit's Psychic weapons.

stratagems.name: Psybolt Ammunition
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] and [PSYCHIC] abilities.
stratagems.summary: Grant [LETHAL HITS] and [PSYCHIC] to unit's ranged weapons.

enhancements.name: Formidable Resolve
enhancements.effect: Improve the bearer's Leadership and Wounds characteristics by 1. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, you can select one friendly Battle-shocked unit within 12" of the bearer. That unit is no longer Battle-shocked.

enhancements.name: Daemon Slayer
enhancements.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons, and those weapons have the **[ANTI-DAEMON 3+]** ability.

enhancements.name: Grimoire of True Names
enhancements.effect: While an enemy unit is within 9" of the bearer, worsen the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1. In addition, while an enemy DAEMON unit is within 9" of the bearer, each time a model in that DAEMON unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Gift of the Prescient
enhancements.effect: Once per battle, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can use the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP. When doing so, you must target a GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit from your army, and when using the Stratagem, that unit can be set up on the battlefield anywhere that is more than 6" from all enemy units.

rules.name: At All Costs
rules.effect:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the following to apply:


**Eliminate At All Costs**
Select one enemy unit on the battlefield. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time an ^^Agents of the Imperium^^ model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.


**Acquire At All Costs**
Select one objective marker on the battlefield. Until the start of your next Command phase, while an ^^Agents of the Imperium^^ unit from your army is within range of that objective marker, improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit by 1 and models in that unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: Violent Acquisition
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of an objective marker, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1], [LANCE] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.
stratagems.summary: [SUSTAINED HITS 1], [LANCE], [IGNORES COVER] on attacks vs enemies near objective markers.

stratagems.name: Masters of the Void
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.cond: One VOIDFARERS CHARACTER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit from your army that is arriving from Strategic Reserves this turn can be set up within your opponent’s deployment zone (all other restrictions still apply).
stratagems.summary: Strategic Reserves arrivals can set up in opponent's deployment zone (other restrictions apply).

stratagems.name: Close-quarters Barrage
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One VOIDFARERS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets a unit within 12", improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.
stratagems.summary: Improve Strength and AP by 1 on ranged attacks targeting units within 12".

stratagems.name: Emperor’s Will
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.cond: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.
stratagems.summary: Eligible to shoot after Advance or Fall Back.

stratagems.name: Displacer Field
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER unit from your army (excluding OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save and, after the attacking unit has resolved its attacks, unless your unit is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6" (when doing so, models in this unit move as if they have the Fly keyword).
stratagems.summary: 4+ invulnerable save; if not in Engagement Range after attacks, move up to 6" (with Fly).

stratagems.name: Selfless Bodyguard
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM Attached unit that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack with the [PRECISION] ability is allocated to a CHARACTER model in your unit, if there are one or more Bodyguard models in your unit, roll one D6: on a 2+, that attack is allocated to a Bodyguard model of your choice in your unit instead.
stratagems.summary: Redirect [PRECISION] attacks from CHARACTER to Bodyguard models (2+ on D6).

stratagems.name: Violent Acquisition
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of an objective marker, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1], [LANCE] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.
stratagems.summary: [SUSTAINED HITS 1], [LANCE], [IGNORES COVER] on attacks vs enemies near objective markers.

stratagems.name: Masters of the Void
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.cond: One VOIDFARERS CHARACTER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit from your army that is arriving from Strategic Reserves this turn can be set up within your opponent’s deployment zone (all other restrictions still apply).
stratagems.summary: Strategic Reserves arrivals can set up in opponent's deployment zone (other restrictions apply).

stratagems.name: Close-quarters Barrage
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One VOIDFARERS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets a unit within 12", improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.
stratagems.summary: Improve Strength and AP by 1 on ranged attacks targeting units within 12".

enhancements.name: Digital Weapons
enhancements.effect: Each time the bearer is selected to fight, roll three D6; for each 4+, one enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer suffers 1 mortal wound. Mortal wounds inflicted by this Enhancement are allocated as if they have the [PRECISION] ability.

enhancements.name: Clandestine Operation
enhancements.effect: At the start of the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select up to three AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY units from your army (excluding GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD units) - those units gain the Infiltrators ability.

enhancements.name: Fleetmaster
enhancements.effect: Once per battle round, you can target the bearer's unit with the Violent Acquisition, Masters of the Void or Close-quarters Barrage Stratagems for 0CP.

enhancements.name: Combat Landers
enhancements.effect: At the start of the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select up to three VOIDFARERS units from your army - those units gain the Deep Strike ability.

rules.name: Extremis Sanction
rules.effect:
^^Officio Assassinorum^^ units from your army can use the Overkill, Soulless Horror and Shieldbreaker abilities twice per battle, instead of once per battle (but cannot use such an ability more than once in the same battle round). 

When mustering your army, each ^^Officio Assassinorum^^ unit from your army has the relevant Extremis ability, and you must increase the points cost of each of those units by the amount shown. If this causes your army to exceed the points limit for the battle you are playing, you cannot include that unit in your army.

stratagems.name: Prime Target
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If that attack is made by an OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM model and it targets the enemy WARLORD, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.
stratagems.summary: Re-roll Wound rolls of 1 vs CHARACTER; OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM models re-roll Wound rolls vs enemy WARLORD.

stratagems.name: Hyperstimms
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in your unit. In addition, if it is an EVERSOR ASSASSIN unit, until the end of the phase, it has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.
stratagems.summary: +1 Toughness; if EVERSOR ASSASSIN, also gains Feel No Pain 4+.

stratagems.name: Will‑sapping Salvo
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. In addition, if it is a CULEXUS ASSASSIN unit, until the end of the phase, change the Damage characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit to 3.
stratagems.summary: Grant [SUSTAINED HITS 1] to unit's ranged weapons; if CULEXUS ASSASSIN, change Damage to 3.

stratagems.name: Orbital Oversight
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18", or, if your unit has the Lone Operative ability, if the attacking model is within 6".
stratagems.summary: Ranged attacks only possible within 18" (6" if Lone Operative).

stratagems.name: Blind Grenades
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
stratagems.cond: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM GRENADES or VINDICARE ASSASSIN unit from your army that was selected as one of the targets of that charge and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from Charge rolls made for that enemy unit, or, if your unit is a VINDICARE ASSASSIN, subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that enemy unit instead.
stratagems.summary: -1 to enemy Charge rolls (-2 if VINDICARE ASSASSIN).

stratagems.name: Ensnaring Trap
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.cond: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY unit from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can declare a charge. When doing so, you must select one or more of those enemy units as the targets of that charge, and your unit does not receive a Charge bonus this turn. In addition, if it is a CALLIDUS ASSASSIN unit and it makes a Charge move as a result of this Stratagem, until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.summary: Declare charge without Charge bonus; if CALLIDUS ASSASSIN, +1 to Wound rolls for melee attacks this turn.

abilities.name: Lone Operative
abilities.effect:
Unless part of an **attached** unit, this unit is not **visible** to enemy models unless they are within 12" of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by **[INDIRECT FIRE]** weapons unless the attacking model is within 12" of this unit. 
If this ability takes the form **Lone Operative X"**, unless part of an **attached** unit, this unit is not **visible** to enemy models unless they are within **X"** of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by **[INDIRECT FIRE]** weapons unless the attacking model is within **X"** of this unit.

abilities.name: Stealth
abilities.effect: If every model in a unit has this ability, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, that unit has the **benefit of cover** against that attack (13.08).

abilities.name: Infiltrators
abilities.effect: During deployment, if every model in a unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from your opponent’s deployment zone and all enemy units.

abilities.name: Shieldbreaker
abilities.effect: Once per battle, when selecting targets for this model’s exitus rifle, it can fire a shieldbreaker round. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time this model makes an attack with that weapon, add 1 to the Wound roll and any successful Wound roll scores a Critical Wound.

abilities.name: Dead-shot
abilities.effect:
When this unit is **selected to shoot**, until this unit has shot: 
- Enemy units do not have Lone Operative. 
- Hidden enemy units have +15" detection range.'

abilities.name: Shadow Assignment
abilities.effect: This model cannot be selected as your WARLORD. If your army faction is AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM, then during the Declare Battle Formations step, you can replace this model with a different OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM model, provided that the points value of the new model does not exceed the points value of the model it replaced. Your army cannot include duplicates of the same model (i.e. after replacing this model with this rule, your army cannot have more than 1 VINDICARE ASSASSIN, it cannot have more than 1 CULEXUS ASSASSIN, it cannot have more than 1 EVERSOR ASSASSIN and it cannot have more than 1 CALLIDUS ASSASSIN).

abilities.name: Lone Operative
abilities.effect:
Unless part of an **attached** unit, this unit is not **visible** to enemy models unless they are within 12" of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by **[INDIRECT FIRE]** weapons unless the attacking model is within 12" of this unit. 
If this ability takes the form **Lone Operative X"**, unless part of an **attached** unit, this unit is not **visible** to enemy models unless they are within **X"** of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by **[INDIRECT FIRE]** weapons unless the attacking model is within **X"** of this unit.

abilities.name: Stealth
abilities.effect: If every model in a unit has this ability, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, that unit has the **benefit of cover** against that attack (13.08).

abilities.name: Deep Strike
abilities.effect: Each time this unit makes an **ingress move** (20.04), if every model in this unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units, even if that is within your opponent’s deployment zone.

abilities.name: Abomination
abilities.effect: This model has the Feel No Pain 2+ ability against Psychic Attacks.

abilities.name: Soulless Horror
abilities.effect: Once per battle, at the start of any Command phase, this model can use this ability. If it does, each enemy unit within 9" of this model must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test (or subtracting 2 if that unit is a PSYKER).

abilities.name: Etheric Emergence
abilities.effect: In your Movement phase, when this model is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, it can perform an etheric emergence. 2. For each selected model, select one of its ranged weapons (excluding **[ONE SHOT]** weapons).

If two or more Toughness characteristics are tied for majority, use the highest value. 
For the purposes of determining which models in this unit can embark within a TRANSPORT, Kill Team Terminator models, Kill Team Outrider models, Kill Team Biker models and models equipped with a jump pack each take up the space of 2 models, but can otherwise embark within any TRANSPORT their unit can embark within, even though similar models in other units have the TERMINATOR, MOUNTED or JUMP PACK keywords. 
For the purposes of interacting with terrain features, all models in units with this ability are considered Infantry models, even though similar models in other units may have the Mounted or Jump Pack keywords.
